description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Awoken Tantalus], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)], [Toxic Break Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Tantalus
description.text: Wind and Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Toxic Break Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Toxic Break after using Poison abilities

description.name: Toxic Break
description.text: Four single attacks (0.67 each), causes [ATK and DEF -50% (8s)]/[MAG and RES -50% (8s)] every 1+2n/2+2n casts
